unit.why: A short anecdote about the Seer of Lublin whose household delayed his early meal, and his choice not to grow angry.

stories.start_quote: סיפר חו"ז הגאוה״ק מראזלא איך שרבינו
stories.end_quote: גם זה רצון קוני שלא אכעוס
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin asked his household to serve the evening meal early so he could rise early for a great tikkun; they served it late instead and spoiled his plan, but he held back his anger, reasoning that not getting angry is also God's will.

quotes: מהראוי לי לכעוס על בני ביתי
גם זה רצון קוני שלא אכעוס
tags.why: The story turns on overcoming anger

quotes: וצוה לבני ביתו שיקדימו לו סעודת הלילה
והם לא די שלא הקדימו אלא אדרבה איחרו
tags.why: The household did not carry out his instruction
The story illustrates the tsaddik's self-control
Restraint of anger shown as a virtue
